# RaggieSoft Help Studio v0.7.0 — Complete `.rshp`, `use help;` RaggieScript & RaggieSoft Reference Portal Guide (`llms-full.txt`)

## 1. CLI Commands (`rshbuild.exe`)

- `rshbuild.exe <project.rshp> [--out-dir=<dir>] [--with-vpat] [--oem-filter=<tag>] [--license-file=<file.rswlic>]`
- `rshbuild.exe --validate [--diagnostics=json] <project.rshp> [--oem-filter=<tag>]`
- `rshbuild.exe --import <input.chm|.hhp|.hlp|.cnt|.hpj> --out-dir=<dir> [--format=markdown|html]`
- `rshbuild.exe --license-status [--diagnostics=json] [--license-file=<file.rswlic>]`
- `rshbuild.exe --emit-ai-spec <dir>`

## 2. Canonical `.rshp` Manifest Grammar (`v0.7.0`)

```ini
; Plain-text comment-preserving RaggieSoft Help Studio project (.rshp)
[Project]
ModuleId                 = publisher.app-name
Name                     = Sample Application
Version                  = 1.0.0
Publisher                = Sample Studio
Description              = Offline F1 context help and web documentation.
DefaultTopic             = welcome
Language                 = en-US
OnlineDocsUrl            = https://raggiesoftstudio.com/help-studio
CanonicalSiteUrl         = https://docs.raggiesoft.dev
SourceRepoUrl            = https://github.com/raggiesoft
CompanionUrl             = https://raggiesoft.dev
CompanionLabel           = Open-Source Hub

[UI]
AccentPrimaryHex         = #107C74
AccentSecondaryHex       = #D97706

[Build]
OutputDir                = out
StandaloneExeName        = SampleAppHelp.exe
BuildModulePack          = true
BuildStandaloneExe       = true
BuildWebPortal           = true
BuildSdkHeaders          = true
BuildVpatReport          = true
WebBasePath              = 
IncludeNetworkBar        = true
ActiveOemFilter          = 
RaggieScript             = scripts/help-rules.rssc

[Topic.welcome]
Title                    = Welcome & Quick Start
Category                 = Getting Started
Source                   = topics/welcome.md
Summary                  = Overview and keyboard shortcuts.
Keywords                 = welcome, f1, shortcuts
OemTags                  = 

[Index.idx-f1]
Term                     = F1 Context Help
Category                 = Shortcuts
Badge                    = Key
Topic                    = welcome
Anchor                   = f1-routing

[ContextMap]
IDH_MAIN_WINDOW = 0x1001 | welcome
IDH_SETTINGS    = 0x1002 | welcome#f1-routing
```

## 3. Sandboxed `RaggieScript` (`use help;`) Hooks

```csharp
use help;

// Conditionally include/exclude topics, register search aliases, and wire F1 Context IDs:
help.includeWhen("enterprise-sso", OEM_FILTER != "lite");
help.registerSearchAlias("welcome", "hotkey");
help.routeContextId(0x2040, "welcome#f1-routing");

test "F1 routing hook smoke test" {
    assert(MODULE_ID != "", "Expected active MODULE_ID define");
}
```

## 4. Diagnostic Codes (`RSH001` – `RSH099` & `RSW700` – `RSW715`)
- `RSH001`: Malformed `.rshp` manifest syntax.
- `RSH002` / `RSH003` / `RSH008`: Missing `ModuleId`, zero topics, or invalid `DefaultTopic`.
- `RSH010`: Missing topic `.md` / `.html` source file on disk.
- `RSH015`: Skipped HTML heading hierarchy (`<h1>` -> `<h3>`, WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1).
- `RSH020`: `<img>` missing `alt` attribute (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1).
- `RSH025`: Unscrubbed Microsoft Word `MsoNormal` or hardcoded `color:black` inline style.
- `RSH030`: Broken internal topic link (`<a href="...">`).
- `RSH040` / `RSH041` / `RSH045`: Duplicate numeric `ContextId`, duplicate `IDH_*` symbol, or unknown target topic.
- `RSH055`: `AccentPrimaryHex` contrast below 4.5:1 vs `#FFFFFF` or 3.0:1 vs `#15203A` Dark Mode card.
- `RSH060`–`RSH065` / `RSW700`–`RSW715`: `RaggieScript` (`use help;`) static type, `RSW702` capability sandbox, `test` assertion, or `reportBrokenAnchor` failure.
- `RSH098` / `RSH099`: Offline `.rswlic` ECDSA P-256 signature error or `Essentials` headless CI/CD scope check.
